axi.stall_predicate: VALID && !READY independently for AW/W/B/AR/R on each side
axi.outstanding: DUT-side accepted AW minus B and AR minus RLAST, max per command
axi.side_by_side: Accepted and retired channel/byte counts must agree at command completion; concurrent stall counters are not summed into latency
axi.existing_monitor: q8_axi_monitor.sv and q8_axi_port.sv from accepted ACT source

phase_accounting.exclusive: AP accept to first issue, first-to-last issue inclusive, and last issue to AP done; all cycles reconcile for a RUN
phase_accounting.overlapping_spans: subcall start/done, scalar FSM sample first/last, output/report entry, AXI traffic and stalls
phase_accounting.unknown: pre-issue and post-issue residual cycles remain explicitly unknown because scalar validation, inter-subcall control, AXI wait and report can overlap; no single cause is inferred from correlated stalls
